blocks.text: Welcome to the Analytics API Reference. Explore the unified Analytics API for all analytics, reporting, and digital experience monitoring.

blocks.item: Analytics API - GraphQL API for analytics, reporting, and digital experience monitoring.

blocks.text: GraphQL is a query language for APIs that provides a complete and understandable description of the data in your API. It gives clients the power to ask for exactly what they need and nothing more.

blocks.item: Precise Data Fetching: Request only the fields you need
Single Request: Get all required data in one API call
Strong Typing: Schema defines exactly what's available
Introspection: Explore the API schema programmatically
